description: A node owed an acknowledgement that also has ARQ data for the same peer sends one DATA-ACK instead of an ACK-ONLY and a DATA-ONLY.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142): window edges at their initial values (C-0782, C-0787), and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). Its soft link is established when the link is made (A-0194). At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY, FSN 0, 'ping' from SAP 5: delivered (cas.first_data stops, S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1) and an acknowledgement is owed (C-0174). At 61500 the client sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3 (TTL 0, so TTD 1296061500, 'pong'); the soft link exists, so it goes down at once as an ARQ C_PDU, and dts.ttd starts. The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms. At 83000 both an acknowledgement and data are due for 0.0.1.3, so they go together as one DATA-ACK (type 11) rather than an ACK-ONLY and a DATA-ONLY (C-0238, C-0239, C-0241, C-1128): its data fields follow the DATA-ONLY rules (C-0243, C-0244, C-1000 to C-1006: FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, both TX WIN flags, segment size 10) and its acknowledgement fields the ACK-ONLY rules (C-1007, C-0245 to C-0247: RX LWE 1, encoding bit 0 for a bitmap, no Selective Acks bytes). 32 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20. At 93350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts; at 101000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 acknowledges FSN 0 (C-0242 is its side): dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): the DATA-ACK leaves 18 bytes of its second block. The acknowledgement it carries is repeated as an ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1, bitmap, offset 0, no Ack Data; 15 bytes, EOT 10), the acknowledgement of a DATA-ACK being repeated with ACK-ONLY D_PDUs (C-0240, C-0882); a second copy does not fit in the 3 bytes left, which also cannot hold a PADDING D_PDU, so they are zero filled.
